releaseTitle: ATalk v3.11.0 — Signature Visual Identity & Tactical Architecture
releaseNotes:
• 01 Signature Visual Identity: 8 new iconic & AGSL wallpapers (Neural Delta, Depth Matrix, Cipher Rain, Quantum Waves, Biometric Flow, Sovereign Orbit, Encrypted Plasma, Holographic Prism) reflecting ATalk's characteristic security and cyberpunk brand identity.
• 02 Wallpaper & Theme Studio Overhaul: 3 categorized tiers (Signature, AGSL Shader, Classic) with live animated miniature preview cards, real-time animation tempo slider (0.5x to 2.0x), and global atmospheric chat feed rendering.
• 03 Tactical Chat Folders: All, Direct, Unread, and Pinned tabs with dynamic live badge counts on ChatListScreen.
• 04 Granular Read Receipt Privacy: Complete control over read receipts via VaultManager and PrivacySettingsScreen for incognito reading without double blue checkmarks.
• 05 Cryptographic SHA-256 Backup Verification: Embedded payload hashes for tamper-proof backups and verified integrity badges in BackupRestoreDialog.
